Muted petrol cloth and auburn patched sailcloth, tar-black leather, weathered driftwood and dull brass rigging. Narrow practical nautical equipment; original angular broken-keel insignia (a simple split V-shaped keel, not an anchor). No bright blue sails, round glass ornaments or generic pirate skulls.
Subject: ONE dense yet readable successor charter port citadel cluster: elevated narrow counting towers and weathered timber warehouses around a central angular quay hall, auburn sailcloth roofs and petrol shutters, dark piles and dull brass structural bindings. Strong tall varied skyline, not round glass domes, blue sails or giant ship. No water, terrain base, background or people; 128x128 logical detail.
